# BUGS — Back Up Gate Solution

> BUGS sells and installs a portable 12V/24V DC backup power unit for electric gate and garage motors. When load shedding or a power outage cuts the mains, BUGS keeps the gate or garage motor running.

## What BUGS does

BUGS is a portable backup power unit for electric gate and garage motors. It connects to a 12V or 24V DC motor and keeps it operating during load shedding or a power outage. The unit is professionally installed once by an accredited installer supplied by BUGS; after that, it recharges from any standard wall socket and operates as a plug-and-play system for every outage after.

BUGS currently supports Centurion gate and garage motors only. Support for other motor brands is planned but not yet available.

## Where BUGS operates

BUGS services Greater Johannesburg, South Africa. It is a mobile installation service with no fixed shopfront or office address.

## Pricing

The BUGS unit costs R4,500 (subject to change). Delivery cost depends on locality. Installation callout is R650/hour based on location; final cost may vary with distance and site conditions.

## Hours

Monday to Friday, 8am–5pm.
